title: A calculated risk: the Salk polio vaccine field trials of 1954
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: The historian reports 623,972 children in vaccine-or-placebo groups and over a million in observed-control groups in the 1954 US field trials, sponsored by the National Foundation for Infantile Paralysis. Trial designs differed; the count is not the number vaccinated or a population adoption rate.
